Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News - highlights: 1. Interview with Nancy Roth, Executive Director, Gay Rights National Lobby, discussing anti-discrimination in immigration policy COMMERCIAL: Carnaval in Rio de Janeiro, Islanders' Club 2. City status granted to West Hollywood, California; city council is formed 3. Anti-gay Texas Senator Phil [Graham] wins election 4. Gay Rights bill passed in Houston, Texas, but may be overturned COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 5. Interview with David Bender, campaigner, discussing the win of Massachusetts' openly gay Senator Gary Studds COMMERCIAL: New York Gay Film Festival 6. National Gay Task Force meeting COMMERCIAL: "The Connection," gay and lesbian newspaper 7. Interview with Pastor Karen Zeigler, Metropolitan Community Church, discusses meeting with National Council of Churches COMMERCIAL: "The Times of Harvey Milk" 8. First census of a gay community, San Francisco COMMERCIAL: Chamberlain and Associates, career service professionals 9. Carol Bellamy, announcement of upcoming appearance COMMERCIAL: Arcos Blancos, San Juan, Puerto Rico 10. Healthline: Conversations with GMHC: Christopher Collins, attorney, discusses the start of Community Health Project COMMERCIAL: "Badlands," a NYC gay bar 11. Sports Report/ closing
The Right Stuff: 1. Media Report/ Current Events COMMERCIAL: Carnaval in Rio de Janeiro, Islanders' Club 2. Terry Miller interviews Quentin Crisp, author/ performer COMMERCIAL: "The Times of Harvey Milk" 3. Quentin Crisp interview continued COMMERCIAL: National Fund for Human Dignity for disabled gays and lesbians 4. Preview of upcoming gay motion picture, "Whispers" COMMERCIAL: Rio Adventure, Orpheo travel agency 5. Interview with Ron Gould, producer of gay film "Whispers"/ closing credits
